description.en: Read camera manufacturer, model, sensor, serial number and version.
description.zh: 读取相机制造商、型号、传感器、序列号和版本信息。

description.en: Camera capabilities including format, read mode, work mode, lane, video mode capabilities and resolution/framerate limits.
description.zh: 相机能力集，包括格式、读取模式、工作模式、Lane、视频模式能力及分辨率/帧率范围。

description.en: Resolution and framerate configuration. Shows preset modes or ROI configuration based on camera capability (0x005C).
description.zh: 分辨率和帧率配置。根据相机能力（0x005C）自动显示预设分辨率模式或 ROI 配置。

description.en: Read current camera status including resolution, frame rate, exposure, gain, temperature, etc.
description.zh: 读取相机当前状态，包括分辨率、帧率、曝光、增益、温度等。

description.en: Configure exposure mode, AE target/strategy, manual exposure time, gain and related parameters.
description.zh: 配置曝光模式、AE 目标/策略、手动曝光时间、增益及相关参数。

description.en: Configure white balance mode, color temperature range, manual R/B gain.
description.zh: 配置白平衡模式、色温范围、手动 R/B 增益。

description.en: Configure ISP parameters: gamma, WDR, sharpening, denoise, saturation, contrast, hue, LDC, LSC, dehaze, DRC, etc.
description.zh: 配置 ISP 参数：Gamma、WDR、锐化、降噪、饱和度、对比度、色调、LDC、LSC、去雾、DRC 等。

description.en: Configure trigger source, trigger number, interval, delay, edge, software trigger and synchronization mode.
description.zh: 配置触发源、触发帧数、间隔、延迟、边沿、软件触发和同步模式。

description.en: Configure day/night mode, IRCUT direction, pin polarity and timer.
description.zh: 配置日夜模式、IRCUT 方向、引脚极性和定时器。

description.en: Configure GPIO output mode and signal reversal.
description.zh: 配置 GPIO 输出模式和信号反转。

description.en: Configure pixel format, image direction, video mode, test image, MIPI clock mode, metadata, etc.
description.zh: 配置像素格式、图像方向、视频模式、测试图像、MIPI 时钟模式、元数据等。

description.en: System-level operations: factory reset, save to flash, reboot, I2C address change, image acquisition control.
description.zh: 系统级操作：恢复出厂设置、保存到 Flash、重启、修改 I2C 地址、采集控制。

description.en: Advanced debug operations: direct sensor register read, redriver register.
description.zh: 高级调试操作：直接读取传感器寄存器、ReDriver 寄存器。
